text: 740 changes addItems to append mapped rows in bulk and then force a full sort. The former insertion search ran for each incoming item. Current sortItems orders the full list and wraps selection preservation around the change. This supports avoiding repeated insertion work during a refresh. It is a static algorithm observation; no measured complexity or UI responsiveness result is claimed.
title: Sort a refreshed Calendar list once after bulk insertion
